name: get_account_summary
description: Overview of the player's account: trainer level, goals, collection counts, data quality (how many Pokémon have IVs/CP), readiness scores, resources entered (Stardust, Rare Candy) and the reference-data version. Call this first for broad questions.

name: list_pokemon
description: List the player's own Pokémon (compact rows with id, species, CP, IVs, level, verdict action and impact). Supports a search expression like 'fire&4*', 'shadow', 'cp1500-', 'iv90-', 'lucario'.

name: get_pokemon_analysis
description: Full deterministic analysis of ONE owned Pokémon by id: verdict (action, cost, when, benefit, explanation), role ratings (raid, gym, Great/Ultra/Master League: now vs potential, tier), evidence list and better alternatives already owned.

name: get_top_priorities
description: The ranked list of the best investments right now (power-ups, evolutions, move changes, PvP builds) with costs and benefits, plus the today/this-week/long-term roadmap.

name: plan_budget
description: Budget planner: given an amount of Stardust, returns three plans (cheapest useful, balanced, maximum long-term) chosen from the player's actual collection under Stardust and Candy constraints.

name: build_raid_team
description: Best six counters from the player's collection against a raid boss (by species name), with moves, estimated damage score, move-change advice, coverage gaps and a relative team estimate. Not a full simulation.

tier.description: Raid tier: 1,3,4,5,mega,mega_legendary. Default 5 for legendary bosses, otherwise 3.

weather.description: Optional weather: Clear, Fog, Overcast, Partly Cloudy, Rainy, Snow, Windy.

name: get_pvp_candidates
description: The player's best Pokémon for a PvP league ranked by suitability (IV stat-product rank + meta score), with the level/CP to power up to and the cost.

name: compare_pokemon
description: Compare two owned Pokémon (by id) across raid, gym and PvP roles and verdicts.

name: get_species_info
description: Pokémon GO facts for a species (not necessarily owned): base stats, types, evolutions with Candy cost, move pool, raid rank estimate, PvP meta scores and best IV spreads per league.

name: find_pvp_only_pokemon
description: Owned Pokémon that are weak for raids but strong for PvP (raid potential low, a league suitability high) — the 'useless for raids but valuable in PvP' list.
